If still tied, all tied players share victory.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Game end: last Worker placed in the Guildhall, then one final round. Resolve end-game building effects first. Silver tiebreak uses raw silver; silver category enters the same raw count. Solo and Works of Wonder/Age of Artisans modes not modelled.
